# Torsten Jansson vädrar optimism: Börjar svänga om nu

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode is an interview with New Wave CEO Torsten Jansson about the company's quarterly report. Sales rose 13.5%, driven mostly by the Cotton Classics acquisition, while organic growth was 2.2% and refunded tariffs added a one-off boost to operating profit. Jansson is more optimistic about the market turning ('börjar svänga om'). He is happy with underlying profitability but wants organic growth of 5-6%, and he expects the 20% margin target to take time because investment spending stays high until H2 next year.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CEO turning optimistic, underlying margin solid with Cotton Classics, investment spending falls in H2 next year, Tenson US launch. Organic growth is still weak at 2.2%.

#### Reasoning

This view comes from the CEO (company insider), not the hosts or an analyst. Headline EBIT growth is flattered by tariff refunds. Comparing first half to first half, EBIT is up just under 10%. Jansson expects organic growth of 5-6% once investments like Dallas open, plus operating leverage as the investment ratio falls from H2 next year. Margin progress toward 20% will take time, and large acquisitions could dilute it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stays below ~5%
- if tariff rules change adversely
- if a large low-margin acquisition dilutes the margin
- if UK weakness spreads

> *"Jag börjar svänga om lite. Jag hoppas att jag har rätt."*
